## Context
Create tests/scripts/test-detect-dso-workflow.sh with 6 behavioral test functions. All tests MUST FAIL before Task 2 (detect-dso-workflow.sh does not exist). Include suite-runner guard so bash tests/run-all.sh remains green during RED phase. Round-trip test must skip gracefully when migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh does not exist.

## Files to Create
- tests/scripts/test-detect-dso-workflow.sh (new file)

## Fuzzy Match Verification

Test:   test-detect-dso-workflow.sh → normalized: testdetectdsoworkflowsh
Contains as substring: YES — fuzzy-match compatible, no .test-index entry needed.

## Suite-Runner Guard (Required)
DETECT_SCRIPT="$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/detect-dso-workflow.sh"
if [ "${_RUN_ALL_ACTIVE:-0}" = "1" ] && [ ! -f "$DETECT_SCRIPT" ]; then
  echo 'SKIP: detect-dso-workflow.sh not yet implemented (RED) — tests deferred'
  printf 'PASSED: 0  FAILED: 0\n'
  exit 0
fi

## Test Functions to Add (6 total)

Script interface: detect-dso-workflow.sh accepts remote URL as argument (or reads from git remote if absent).
Preferred test invocation: bash detect-dso-workflow.sh <url> (pass URL as argument to avoid git mock complexity).

1. test_detect_https_github_returns_ci_pr
   Given: remote URL https://github.com/org/repo.git
   When: bash detect-dso-workflow.sh https://github.com/org/repo.git
   Then: stdout=ci-pr, exit 0

2. test_detect_ssh_github_returns_ci_pr
   Given: remote URL git@github.com:org/repo.git
   When: bash detect-dso-workflow.sh git@github.com:org/repo.git
   Then: stdout=ci-pr, exit 0

3. test_detect_gitlab_returns_local
   Given: remote URL https://gitlab.com/org/repo.git
   When: bash detect-dso-workflow.sh https://gitlab.com/org/repo.git
   Then: stdout=local, exit 0

4. test_detect_no_remote_returns_local
   Given: empty/absent remote URL (pass empty string)
   When: bash detect-dso-workflow.sh ""
   Then: stdout=local, exit 0

5. test_detect_enterprise_github_returns_local
   Given: remote URL https://github.mycompany.com/org/repo.git (enterprise, not github.com)
   When: bash detect-dso-workflow.sh https://github.mycompany.com/org/repo.git
   Then: stdout=local, exit 0

6. test_detect_round_trip_onboarding_output_accepted_by_migrator
   Purpose: validates that a dso-config.conf written by onboarding (dso.workflow=ci-pr) is accepted by the migrator as already-migrated (no-op on run, sentinel created, second run is no-op)
   Guard: skip when plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh does not exist
   Given: temp fixture dir with .claude/dso-config.conf containing only dso.workflow=ci-pr (LF endings, no comments, no legacy keys)
   When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir>
   Then: exit 0; fixture config file content unchanged; .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated sentinel exists
   Also: second migrator run exits 0 immediately (true idempotency)

Add entries for all 6 test functions so the test gate tracks RED state:
  [test_detect_https_github_returns_ci_pr]=tests/scripts/test-detect-dso-workflow.sh
  [test_detect_ssh_github_returns_ci_pr]=tests/scripts/test-detect-dso-workflow.sh
  [test_detect_gitlab_returns_local]=tests/scripts/test-detect-dso-workflow.sh
  [test_detect_no_remote_returns_local]=tests/scripts/test-detect-dso-workflow.sh
  [test_detect_enterprise_github_returns_local]=tests/scripts/test-detect-dso-workflow.sh

  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -v FAIL | tail -5

  Verify: shellcheck tests/scripts/test-detect-dso-workflow.sh
- [ ] All 6 test functions present in test file
  Verify: grep -c 'test_detect_' tests/scripts/test-detect-dso-workflow.sh | grep -q '6'
- [ ] All 6 tests FAIL when invoked directly (without suite-runner guard, with script absent)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-detect-dso-workflow.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAILED'
- [ ] .test-index has RED markers for all 6 test functions
  Verify: grep -c 'test_detect_' .test-index | grep -q '6'
- [ ] Round-trip test skips gracefully when migrator absent
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-detect-dso-workflow.sh 2>&1 | grep -i 'skip\|SKIP'
